name: Shirakomachi Kikyou
source:
A daughter of the Shirakomachi household, a prestigious household among the Komainu race which is famous for giving birth to top-class bodyguards. At Aoe household she acts as a bodyguard and a maid at the same time for Kuon and her parents.

Ever since Taichi and Kuon started performing the awakening ritual, she is ordered by Mai to become Taichi's exclusive bodyguard.
